_note: The wheel holds the chapter 12 library and the protocol module (standard library only) and, in the folder ch12-evidence beside them, the saved files the worked examples read, as in the earlier wheel, byte for byte. The boot snippet runs the setup of the deck's chapter-code manifest chapter_code_ch12_v1_4_0.json once (L = the library, R = the recorded run of Bitcoin Core 31.1, hashlib) and makes those names ready in every program.
